description: Delete a revoked end user's scoped state and vault-token rows, de-identify its calls rows (kept, never deleted), and set purged_at. Requires the end user to be revoked first (revoke_required otherwise). Returns {state_rows, vault_tokens} counts.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.enduser.purge
